discussion.body:
Workspace prototype, not a push to Stackocakes-Hub/Asteria. HEAD not moved.
User asked Act 0 be buildable in Grok workspace. Static harness lives at artifacts/asteria-web/. Open with python3 -m http.server --directory artifacts/asteria-web.
Implements the two-main board: Cael solo shed/harvest/road; Liraen joins at The Low Tide; Halric cameo at custom house; Rook cameo at quay; dusk lock; veil fight; FEAT-052; title card; east gate; localStorage asteria.save.v1. ATB Attack/Wait. Plot armor both.
Official Asteria/web remains the impl daily target and is still the older Cael-only placeholder. This folder is the design-side playable spec. No Godot. No vault binaries.
